entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Franz Cižek was a Czech-Austrian genre and portrait painter, and teacher. He was a reformer of art education. He began the Child Art Movement in Vienna, opening the Juvenile Art Class in 1897.

entities.summary: Franz Cižek was a Czech-Austrian genre and portrait painter, and teacher. He was a reformer of art education. He began the Child Art Movement in Vienna, opening the Juvenile Art Class in 1897.
